stories.subject: Jay-Z / JAŸ-Z30 Yankee Stadium box-office record
stories.headline: JAY-Z SETS A STADIUM RECORD
stories.deck: Three Yankee Stadium shows grossed $42.29 million on 136,934 tickets. Touring Data calls it the biggest rap concert engagement total reported.
stories.verification: AllHipHop and Kicks & Grips report the same Touring Data figures; the Yankees confirm the JAŸ-Z30 anniversary residency and venue context.

stories.subject: Erykah Badu / European tour cancellations
stories.headline: BADU CANCELS FIVE EUROPE DATES
stories.deck: Paris, Milan, Sofia and Katowice are canceled over unforeseen circumstances. London, Amsterdam, Brussels and Basel remain scheduled.
stories.verification: AllHipHop and antiMusic report the five cancellations and four retained dates; Badu’s tour page corroborates the European itinerary.

stories.subject: Young Nudy / Just Doin Me album announcement
stories.headline: YOUNG NUDY SETS THE NEXT RUN
stories.deck: Apple Music lists Just Doin Me for Oct. 28, following “Who Dat Is.” Public listings currently disagree on 17 versus 19 tracks.
stories.verification: Apple Music provides the dated pre-release listing; AllHipHop and HotNewHipHop report the rollout, “Who Dat Is,” and the unresolved track-count mismatch.

stories.subject: Drake and Don Toliver / Solar Eclipse official video
stories.headline: DRAKE + DON TAKE THE ECLIPSE
stories.deck: “Solar Eclipse” now has an official visual from the FOMO rollout. The Don Toliver collaboration followed the song’s Oct. 2 streaming release.
stories.verification: Complex reports the official YouTube upload and FOMO context; Apple Music lists the music video and Billboard Canada confirms the collaboration and interpolation detail.

stories.subject: DistroKid / UMG claim-driven recording removals
stories.headline: DISTROKID PULLS SONGS AMID CLAIMS
stories.deck: DistroKid says a small number of recordings were removed after UMG claims. Artists report little notice or appeal while the lawsuit remains unresolved.
stories.verification: The Verge reports DistroKid’s statement and artists’ complaints; USA News Group and the Delaware docket corroborate the removals context and pending lawsuit.

source_policy: Five distinct current hip-hop stories; each checked against at least two reputable or primary sources; topics excluded from the Oct. 11 morning batch and prior automation memory.
